svg.text: (a) Dispatch: split, then merge across 4 nodes; each window gates a row-slice of every local expert
① merge: 1 row per (token, dest node)
chunk 0 of the N0→N1 stream pulled to GPU0
② split: equal ¼ chunks per NIC
③ wire: 1 blocking put per remote node, to the same-rank gateway of that node
⑤ gate: E3 rows from this window unblock
Per rank per dispatch: 3 NIC puts (one per remote node), 3 NVLink pulls (split), 12 NVLink fan-out puts as gateway. Every NIC carries ¼ of its node's stream to each destination.
grouped GEMM: own-node rows → window rows as they land
E3 tiles: own rows → N2 rows → N3 rows → N0 rows

Rank 0 medians, K2 4n b64 efficient case (capsule 20260905-141104, iter4): first put 5.1 ms, three back-to-back 3.4 ms puts (NIC gap ≤0.01 ms), GEMM starts 0.2 ms after the first put on own-node rows; windows land 10.1 / 11.9 / 15.3; GEMM ends 1.4 ms after the last window.
